AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

19. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

21. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
